protocolDosing.notes: community/anecdotal; no human studies; preclinical t½ ~4 h applies to preclinical route only; poor oral bioavailability in preclinical models

mechanismOfAction.summary: REV-ERBα/β agonist; represses Bmal1/Clock gene expression to alter circadian rhythms and metabolic gene programs.
mechanismOfAction.description: Nuclear receptor REV-ERB (NR1D1/NR1D2) agonist with EC50 ~790 nM REV-ERBα and ~560 nM REV-ERBβ. Represses clock gene Bmal1 expression; upregulates fatty acid oxidation genes; reduces inflammatory gene expression. Better oral bioavailability than SR9009. Human PK not established; t½ ~4 h is preclinical only.
